art_direction: 短宽眼口共同微仰，底线一长一短，黑瞳留纸缝，无嘴。
composition: centered hand-drawn eye pair; auxiliary marks only when specified; large blank paper margins

color_randomization.method: golden-angle hue spacing with seeded single-hue saturation and lightness variation

color_treatment: one opaque flat color beside each pupil; no gradient or shaded rendering
creative_direction: Use short broad eye openings rather than long almonds. Draw the upper lid with an upward pen bend and the lower lid as a loose bowl, stopping before either corner closes. Make one bottom stroke shorter than the other. Both large pupils sit a little high, with a thin irregular paper gap inside. Give each eye one small brow dash. No mouth. Let the pen pressure change once per stroke, without adding scratchy filler.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
